engines.name: Authorization Decision Engine
engines.inputs: actor; tenant; action; resource; scope; policy; session risk
engines.outputs: allow/deny; reason; matched policy; effective scope; decision_id

engines.name: Configuration Resolution Engine
engines.inputs: configuration key; environment; tenant; company; project; user; date
engines.outputs: effective value; source layer; version; validation

engines.name: Workflow Orchestration Engine
engines.inputs: workflow definition; object; variables; events; timers

engines.name: Rules Evaluation Engine
engines.core_rule: Same inputs and version yield same result

engines.name: Job Dispatch Engine
engines.inputs: job type; priority; tenant; capacity; retry policy
engines.outputs: worker lease; execution schedule; retry/dead-letter outcome

engines.name: Search Indexing Engine
engines.inputs: source object; schema; ACL; analyzer configuration

engines.name: Synchronization Engine
engines.inputs: offline transactions; server versions; conflict policies

engines.name: Unit Conversion Engine
engines.inputs: value; source unit; target unit; precision

engines.name: Currency Conversion Engine
engines.inputs: amount; source currency; target currency; rate source/date

engines.name: AI Policy Engine
engines.inputs: actor; tenant; agent; model; prompt; data classes; tool request
engines.core_rule: Intersection of user, agent, tenant, and tool policy

engines.name: AI Cost Metering Engine
engines.inputs: model usage; tokens; tools; tenant pricing profile
engines.outputs: usage record; estimated cost; allocation dimensions
